caption: The drawing features two main elements on a plain, light background. At the top, there is a horizontal decorative band with a pattern that includes blue, red, and green flowers and foliage, intertwined with brown curving stems or vines. The band is bordered on the top and bottom with a thin blue line, and a subtle beige line above. Below this, there is a pair of suspenders that appear to be made of beige or light tan fabric, each decorated with floral motifs in blue, red, and green colors as well as swirling brown designs. The suspenders have tan or beige leather ends with buttonholes, and sections wrapped with a ribbed pattern that suggests stitched or woven details. Both objects are rendered with a realistic approach and are shown clearly against the empty background, with the suspenders positioned side-by-side, slightly angled toward each other.
title: Suspenders
